name: YB token buyback bot sandwiched through sell-triggered swapbuy
summary: Every sell of YB into its pair made the token call its bot's swapbuy(), which spent the bot's USDT buying YB at the current pool price without any slippage bound. The attacker flash-borrowed USDT, bought YB from 66 fresh contracts, then sold it back in 66 slices, each sale triggering a bot buy that lifted the price before the next, draining the bot's USDT.
notes: The bot 0x113f16a3 is unverified and older than YB; it was pointed at YB (slot 2) in 0x68a0a839 and YB's setBot (slot 3) followed in 0x2deb10e4, the latest change the exploit needed. Later owner changes are trading launch (startTradeBlock), botSell off, swap/wallet limits and the sell-fee cut from 24% to 4% three hours before the exploit; they gate or size the attack but are not reset fields (rule 8).

Loss is the bot's USDT outflow, its whole balance; the 96.7 YB it bought is not netted, and the USDT that reached the pair and fee wallets is not subtracted (rule 11). The bot's earlier and later USDT outflows are under 300 USDT per transaction or owner withdrawals.
